capabilities: Add color-coded highlights to selected text via a context menu
Remove HTML mark tags with an Unhighlight command
Customize highlight colors in the settings tab
Choose between inline CSS and generated CSS classes
Open the highlighter menu with commands and per-color hotkeys
extras: Warns that the plugin component does not work with the cMenu plugin.
motivation: The author wanted custom-color highlighting in notes without relying on CSS hacks, proprietary formatting, or non-native Templater workarounds.
problem: Markdown highlights have no custom colors, and HTML mark tags with inline CSS are tedious to type out by hand.

relations.evidence: how about a Templater template? Kinda like this one. But this just doesn't feel… native.

summary: Highlighting menu that wraps selected text in colored HTML mark tags with customizable highlight colors.
